title: Quality Control Chemist - I*
description:
Job Title - Quality Control Chemist
Location - Frederick, MD
Duration: 5 months
PR: $25/hr to $28/hr
 
 
Shift flexibility preferred Wed-Saturday
IMPORTANT: For the first 7 weeks of the assignment, all contractors are required to work Mon-Fri (0730-1600) to complete New Hire Orientation and Manufacturing On-boarding Technical Training. After the 7 weeks, the contractor is deployed onto their agreed upon shift. New hires will need to complete
 
Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
  • Perform testing of raw materials, intermediates and final products by following analytical methods: Cell based bioassays, Flow Cytometry, ELISA and qPCR assays.
  • Work with internal and external resources to maintain lab in an optimal state.
  • Assist with monitoring and trending data, complete routine record review of test data and related documents for in-process testing, drug substance and drug product release. Supply information to support generation of CoAs for product release.
  • Maintains laboratory instruments for calibration and routine maintenance
  • Author or revise SOPs, qualification/validation protocols and reports.
  • Asist with lab investigations regarding out of specifications (OOS) results. Participate in determination of root cause for deviations related to analytical procedures.
  • Provide updates at daily and weekly meetings.
  • Monitor the GMP systems currently in place to ensure compliance with documented policies.
  • Review proposed changes to systems, procedures, methods, and submissions to regulatory agencies, as appropriate.
  • Gather metric information for use in continuous improvement of areas of responsibility.
  • Perform other duties as required.
 
Basic Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree OR
  • AA Degree and 2+ years' experience in biotechnology or related field and Quality Control experience OR
  • High School Degree and 3+ years' experience in biotechnology or related field and Quality Control experience
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Strong knowledge of GMP, SOPs and quality control processes.
  • Identifying, writing, evaluating, and closing OOS's and investigations.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, Power Point and other applications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate and work independently with scientific/technical personnel.
  • Well versed in various analytical techniques such as Flow Cytometry, ELISAs, PCR, and cell bioassays and other applicable methods to the testing of biopharmaceuticals.
  • Working knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements (21 CRF Part 11/210/211).
  • Preferred: Experience in the biotech and/or pharmaceutical industry.
 
 
 
Thanks and Regards
Sharif Khan
Senior Recruiter

South San Francisco, CA 94080

title: Data Engineer Level 3
description:
Job Description

LeadStack Inc. is an award winning, one of the nation's fastest growing, certified minority owned (MBE) staffing services provider of contingent workforce. As a recognized industry leader in contingent workforce solutions and Certified as a Great Place to Work, we're proud to partner with some of the most admired Fortune 500 brands in the world.


Job Title: Data Engineer Level 3
Location: Blue Ash, OH (Hybrid – 4 Days Onsite per Week)
Duration: 12 Months
Pay Rate: $60/hr – $85/hr on W2
Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team. In this role, you will play a key part in building and scaling the organization’s behavioral and Ecommerce data platform, enabling trusted analytics and making AI-ready data available across the enterprise.
This is a delivery-focused engineering role that requires deep technical expertise in Azure, Databricks, and Synapse, along with experience managing large-scale behavioral data in complex enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will excel in translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and platform capabilities.
Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or similar roles, with hands-on delivery of cloud-based data solutions.
  • Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate and Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
  • Strong expertise in Databricks and Azure Synapse, with real-world experience in Spark-based data processing.
  • Proficiency in modern data architectures (Lakehouse, ELT/ETL pipelines, real-time data processing).
  • Advanced SQL skills for data transformation and performance tuning.
  • Proven track record of modeling and managing large-scale behavioral and Ecommerce datasets.
  • Deep understanding of BI best practices, data enablement, and self-service analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog and data cataloging tools such as Alation for governance and metadata management.
  • Working knowledge of behavioral analytics tools, including Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical details into business value.
  • Experience operating in agile delivery environments (Jira, Confluence).
  • Demonstrated technical leadership experience as a Lead Engineer.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable ELT/ETL pipelines and data transformations using Databricks, Spark, and Synapse.
  • Model high-volume, complex event-level data (digital behavior, Ecommerce transactions, marketing interactions) to enable dashboards, ML models, and marketing analytics.
  • Enforce data governance and lineage tracking using Unity Catalog and Alation.
  • Validate and reconcile data with behavioral datasets such as Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Analytics.
  • Partner with data architects, analysts, data scientists, and marketing teams to deliver reusable, high-quality datasets that support BI and decision-making.
  • Enhance data ingestion, processing, and orchestration capabilities using Delta Lake optimization, Databricks Workflows, and Synapse.
  • Support and optimize semantic models and data marts for AI/BI dashboards and Power BI self-service analytics.
  • Participate in Agile sprints, including planning, backlog refinement, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of data assets, transformations, and pipelines to ensure transparency and long-term maintainability.
  • Facilitate clear, continuous communication between business and engineering teams to align priorities and deliver value.

Global Program Manager (Contractor)
Role Overview
The Global Program Manager (GPM) serves as a strategic partner to the Product Team Leader (PTL) and Development Lead, driving cross-functional alignment, managing timelines and risks, and enabling informed decision-making across the Product Team (PT) and Research and Development Team (RDT). The GPM holds primary accountability for overall program outcomes.

Job Responsibilities
• Drive alignment across program interdependencies and portfolio-level goals.
• Partner with PTL and Development Lead to execute program strategy.
• Lead goal setting, progress tracking, and outcome communication across teams and stakeholders.
• Ensure data accuracy and timeline integrity within enterprise portfolio and timeline systems.
• Responsible for maintaining accurate and current program information across online systems and dashboards.
• Elevate and track risks, ensuring mitigation plans are in place.
• Prepare teams for governance engagements (Portfolio Committee, Development Review Committee), ensuring readiness and alignment.
• Lead bi-annual operating plan processes, ensuring accurate cost forecasting.
• Collaborate with finance, operations, and functional leads to manage budgets and resources.
• Facilitate effective communication and decision-making across cross-functional teams.
• Monitors and reports on program health and key performance indicators to ensure transparency and alignment with leadership
• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Develops executive-ready materials to communicate program status, strategy and recommendations.

Basic Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business or related discipline, and 10+ years of pharmaceutical/biotech experience
• Strong foundation in project management principles; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.
• Extensive experience in project management within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

Preferred Qualifications
• Deep functional expertise in at least one domain: Research, Development, or Commercialization.
• Solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle, experience in Early Development strong preferred.
• Oncology and cell therapy experience strongly preferred.
• Proven ability to influence without direct authority and foster strong cross-functional collaboration.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into actionable insights.
• Strategic problem-solver with a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity.
• Self-motivated, adaptable, and effective in fast-paced, evolving environments.
• Experience with Planisware or similar enterprise project portfolio management tools preferred.

title: Media Coordinator/Specialist
description:
The Media Coordinator/Specialist supports the Owned & Operated Media team in the planning and execution of promotional content across USN linear and digital platforms for the full WBD portfolio. This role is critical to the flawless execution of strategic media plans and requires a high level of precision, organization, and cross-functional collaboration.

We are seeking candidates with prior experience in strategic implementation of broadcast logs and digital placements. This is not a creative or product development role, but rather one focused on leveraging analytics to inform media planning (communication) and execution.

Job Responsibilities / Typical Day in the Role

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for implementation across WBD USN O&O media inventory.
  • Execute daily and weekly promotional priorities with a focus on accurate log scheduling and timely delivery.
  • Set up campaigns in linear and digital scheduling systems, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
  • Traffic digital video and display creatives using platforms such as Google Ad Manager, Freewheel, and Campaign Manager, ensuring proper placement across inventory.
  • Monitor campaign performance and conduct data analysis for both linear and digital media efforts.
  • Assist in building custom audience targets using data sources such as Nielsen and 1st/3rd party analytics.
  • Resolve discrepancy reports from the Broadcast Center regarding promos, including during off-hours as part of an on-call rotation.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Media Logistics, Digital Agencies, and Commercial Operations to ensure network strategies are followed and troubleshoot technical issues as needed.
  • Produce ad hoc reports and support additional duties as assigned.
Must Have Skills / Requirements
  1. Broadcast Log Scheduling & Media Operations Interest or Experience
  2. Digital Trafficking & Platform Experience
  3. Data Analysis & Audience Targeting
Screening Must Haves
  1. Strong relationship with numbers
  2. Interest in media
  3. Fearlessness to ask questions
Nice to Have Skills / Preferred Requirements
  1. Familiarity with building custom audiences.
  2. Understanding how linear and digital media complement each other in a cross-platform promotional strategy.
  3. Prior work in a TV network, or media agency environment, especially with promotional scheduling.
Soft Skills
  1. Highly motivated individual who takes initiative and has a positive demeanor.
  2. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in scheduling and trafficking tasks.
  3. Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  4. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively across various departments and levels of the organization.
  5. Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Technology Requirements
  1. Familiarity with media systems and platforms such as Google Ad Manager, Freewheel, and Nielsen tools. Also excellent working knowledge of Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint.
Education / Certifications
  1. Must have completed a Bachelors Degree in Communications/Advertising or a related field.
Interview Process / Next Steps
  1. 1st round with HM
  2. 2nd round with HM and Lead
  3. 3rd round with Senior Manager

description:
LeadStack Inc. is an award-winning, one of the nation's fastest-growing, certified minority-owned (MBE) staffing services provider of contingent workforce. As a recognized industry leader in contingent workforce solutions and Certified as a Great Place to Work, we're proud to partner with some of the most admired Fortune 500 brands in the world.
 
Job title: Salesforce Administrator - Partner Portal
Duration: 1 year contract with possible extension
Location: Remote
 
Pay Rate: $120/hr on W2
 
Job Description
About the Role

  • As a Salesforce Administrator - Partner Portal at Client, you will play a key role in building and maintaining world-class CRM systems for our GTM team. Your primary responsibility will be evaluating and implementing a partner portal, requiring deep Salesforce expertise and cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you'll work both autonomously and collaboratively to design and implement tactical and project-related deliverables that support our business growth. You'll work closely with other Revenue Operations team members and business partners to understand requirements and drive strategic solutions, always with a focus on flexibility, maintainability, and scale.
Responsibilities
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of a partner portal, including requirements gathering, solution design, and execution
  • Support additional Salesforce administrator projects for partnerships and RevOps teams
  • Configure and customize Salesforce to meet business needs
  • Design and develop high quality solutions in an agile environment including partner management, routing automation, internationalization, pipeline optimization, and lead management processes
  • Work closely with operations and business partners to understand and refine requirements, objectives, and processes
  • Build for scale by designing holistically, with a focus on flexibility and maintainability
  • Ensure appropriate controls and documentation are followed to create an effective control environment
  • Deal with ambiguity in a rapidly changing business environment, resolve problems and offer impacting solutions
  • Configure and maintain other business systems like Hubspot, Apollo, and Clay
  • Build and optimize integrations between Salesforce and other platforms
You may be a good fit if you
  • Have 5+ years of Salesforce admin experience
  • Have experience implementing and maintaining partner portals and partner management solutions
  • Hold Salesforce Basic and Advanced Certifications (Advanced Administrator certification, Advanced Developer or Platform II certification)
  • Have in-depth understanding of the capabilities and constraints of the Salesforce CRM application architecture
  • Have experience with data migration and integrating Salesforce with other platforms/services
  • Have proven experience scaling Salesforce implementations in high-growth environments
  • Have experience working closely with and implementing solutions for a fast-growing GTM organization
  • Possess excellent analytical skills, combined with impeccable business judgment
  • Can communicate effectively with management, sales, marketing, vendors and international teams

(nice to have) Have 3+ years of Salesforce developer experience
